title: Connecting law for normalized Cech comparison morphisms
statement: Given a normalized Cech comparison system c on an open cover, for every sectionwise-surjective short exact coefficient sequence the stored comparison morphisms satisfy the connecting-map identity.

proof.text: The identity is exactly the connecting field of the supplied CechComparisonSystem; project that field.

lean.statement:
theorem cechComparisonSystem_comparison_connecting
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens) (hcover : iSup U = ⊤)
    (c : CechComparisonSystem U hcover)
    (q : ℕ) (T : ShortComplex
      (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}))
    (hT : T.ShortExact)
    (hg : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι),
      Function.Surjective (T.g.hom.app (op (⨅ l, U (y l))))) :
    TopCat.Sheaf.cechδ U hT hg q ≫ (c.comparison (q + 1)).app T.X₁ =
      (c.comparison q).app T.X₃ ≫ Sheaf.functorHδ hT q

statement_change.old_statement: Let X be a scheme and U an open cover. Given comparison morphisms from Cech cohomology to sheaf cohomology in every degree, for every sectionwise-surjective short exact coefficient sequence the comparison morphisms satisfy the connecting-map identity.
statement_change.what: Replace the false universal quantification over arbitrary degreewise comparison morphisms by a supplied CechComparisonSystem, whose connecting field carries the required compatibility. The conclusion uses c.comparison.

source.place: Lemmas 20.11.2 and 20.15.1; compatibility is part of the normalized comparison system interface

citers.note: Its previous proof applied the old arbitrary-family theorem; after the interface correction it requires a direct compatible-system construction.

old_proof.text: For a sectionwise-surjective short exact sequence, the Cech complexes are short exact. Horseshoe resolutions and naturality of homology boundaries identify the Cech and sheaf connecting morphisms, yielding the displayed identity.
